instructions.question: What overall sentiment does the tweet convey, judging by the author's clear feeling or, for news, by whether the event is clearly good or bad?
instructions.rule: Positive and negative need a clear feeling. Mild grumbles, sports analysis, corrections, banter, waiting or missing out, plans, invites, promos and mild hopes are neutral. News takes the sentiment of a clearly good event (achievement, first, win) or bad event (injury, death, violence, failure); otherwise it is neutral.

neutral.what: Facts, neutral news, questions, plans, promos, mild opinions, sports analysis, banter, mild grumbles.
examples: its the 63rd of july and we are still waiting for frank ocean's new album
Imma need Brook Lopez to get more aggressive on the boards. 7 feet tall, c’mon son
Going to see Paper Towns on Saturday. I'm hoping it does the book justice.
neutral.cues: still waiting, I guess, tomorrow, this Friday, who's coming, should, I think, lol
neutral.not_for: Insults, real sadness or bad-event news are negative; open gushing is positive.

positive.what: Clear enthusiasm, love, praise, gratitude or well-wishes, or news of a clearly good outcome.
examples: noel fielding may be one of the greatest people alive.
Inbetweeners movie coming to cinemas in Ireland on the 19th of August. I have never wanted to see a movie so bad!! #shouldbegood ;)
Saudi voters elect 20 women candidates for the 1st time: Two women were elected in Saudi Arabia's most conserv...
positive.cues: love, best, greatest, can't wait, so excited, loved this, condolences, haha
positive.not_for: Plans, invites, hype ads and mild hopes are neutral.

negative.what: Strong complaint, hostility, insult, ridicule or real sadness, or news of a clearly bad event.
examples: Dream High 2 sucks compared to the 1st one.
Gavin Henson looks set to miss the Rugby World Cup after dislocating a bone in his right wrist yesterday
The best way to find Malaysia Airlines Flight MH370 may be with Michelle Obama's arms.
negative.cues: sucks, disappointed, hate, wtf, :(, injured, failed drug test, shot dead
negative.not_for: Mild critique, small annoyances and playful teasing are neutral.
